image_description: A close-up, high-resolution shot of the head and upper jaw of a crocodile. The image focuses on the textured, armored skin, the eye with a vertical pupil, and the open mouth displaying interlocking conical teeth. The snout is visible, showing the characteristic V-shape.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Head is broad and triangular with a V-shaped snout (narrower than alligator).
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible portion of the snout tapers to a point, consistent with the V-shape of a crocodile rather than the U-shape of an alligator.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Jaws are massive with numerous conical, interlocking teeth visible when mouth is closed.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The checkpoint specifies 'when mouth is closed'. The image depicts the mouth in an open position, making this specific state untestable, although the teeth themselves are visible and conical.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Eyes are positioned dorsally on the head with vertical slit pupils and a nictitating membrane.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The eye is clearly visible on the top of the head (dorsal), features a distinct vertical slit pupil, and the surrounding anatomy matches crocodilian morphology.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Nostrils are positioned at the tip of the snout.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The extreme tip of the snout where nostrils would be located is cut off by the left edge of the frame.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body is elongated and heavily armored.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Only the head and neck are visible; the full body length cannot be verified.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body is covered in thick, bony scutes (osteoderms) arranged in regular longitudinal rows along the dorsal surface.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The skin texture on the head and visible neck area shows heavy, rough armor plating consistent with osteoderms/scutes.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Scutes are dark brown to grey with a rough, heavily textured appearance.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The coloration is greyish-brown and the texture is visibly rough and detailed.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Ventral surface is covered in smooth, rectangular scales that are pale yellow to white.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The underside (ventral surface) of the body is not visible in this angle.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Limbs are short and stout with webbed feet; forelimbs have five digits, hind limbs have four.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Limbs are completely outside the frame.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Tail is laterally compressed and muscular, comprising half of total body length.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The tail is not visible in the frame.
